learning_objective: 🎯 Time to hit the track! You will learn the awesome basics of running, jumping, and throwing just like an Olympic athlete.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Running is the base of almost every sport! It is all about moving your arms and legs in a smooth rhythm. Good posture and breathing are the keys to running fast.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🦘 Up in the Air: Jumping Basics
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Jumping is about pushing off the ground with power and landing softly to protect your knees. It helps build super strong leg muscles!
Throwing involves your whole body, not just your arm! You step forward, twist your waist, and use your core strength to launch a ball far away.

fun_activity.title: 🎯 Target Practice
fun_activity.instructions: Roll up a pair of clean socks into a ball. Place a laundry basket 10 steps away and practice your overhand throw to score 5 points!

quick_recap: ⭐ Athletics is the foundation of sports, focusing on running, jumping, and throwing.
⭐ Good posture makes you run faster and prevents you from getting tired too quickly.
⭐ Jumping requires powerful take-offs and soft, safe landings.
